properties.note: Jackson County's 56 precincts are the Census 2020 voting districts, which carry the county's own 56 precinct names 56/56 and sum to its exact 2020 population of 52,974. Most features carry their County Board district; THREE carry a list of two instead — Carbondale 21, Carbondale 24 and Murphysboro 4 are split between districts, which the county's own certified canvass states by reporting each of them twice with its registration divided. For those three the precinct does not determine the district and the card says so. No polling place ships: a polling place is a roster fact rather than geometry.
properties.source: Census 2020 voting districts and blocks, composed from Jackson County's certified 5 November 2024 General canvass and, inside the three precincts that canvass reports under two districts, from the county's own adopted Board District Map of 26 July 2022
